message.name: EMERGENCY_TELEPORT.DESCR.U3B
message.value: Instantly transfers unit to a random point at a middle range. Doesn't waste a turn. Can be used in the air. Avoids mines and laser beams. Causes explosion at initial point, that destroys nearest guardians.

message.name: EMERGENCY_TELEPORT.DISTINCT.U3B
message.value: Causes explosion at initial point, that destroys guardians.

message.name: BOULDER.NAME.U3
message.value: Sky crasher

message.name: BOULDER.DISTINCT.U3
message.value: Boulder falls down from the sky. Causes explosion upon impact and another one after full stop.

dictionary.message: A huge boulder that falls down from the sky and tumbles chaotically over the map! Throws units into the air, dealing damage depending on boulder's speed. auses explosion upon impact and another one after full stop.

message.name: BOULDER.DAMAGE.U3
message.value: Totally unpredictable!

dictionary.message: Very chaotic. You can cause serious damage to enemy, if you surround them with girders.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.NAME.U1
message.value: Energy rifle 2000

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Victim bounces 2 times after being damaged.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DAMAGE.U1
message.value: 70 hp from shot, 20 hp from each bounce

dictionary.message: Shoots an energy bullet, which damages victim and makes them bounce into the air several times, dealing extra damage. Damage isn't dependant on attack and armor.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.NAME.U2
message.value: Energy rifle 3000

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DISTINCT.U2
message.value: Victim bounces 3 times after being damaged.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DAMAGE.U2
message.value: 65 hp from shot, 20 hp each bounce

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.NAME.U3
message.value: Energy rifle 4000

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DISTINCT.U3
message.value: Victim bounces 4 times under this receiving damage.

message.name: ENERGY_RIFLE.DAMAGE.U3
message.value: 60 hp from shot, 20 hp from each bounce

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.NAME.U3A
message.value: Dino slayer

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DISTINCT.U3A
message.value: Ignores 60% of victim's armor, damage increased to 140 hp. Laser beam fluctuations are lowered by 33%. Increased beam length, ground piercing distance, and distance of maximal damage.

dictionary.message: It's capable to piercing several enemies with one shot, but each subsequent target gets lower damage. Ignores 60% of victim's armor.

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DAMAGE.U3A
message.value: 140 hp for the first target.

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.NAME.U3B
message.value: Wasp slayer

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DISTINCT.U3B
message.value: Damage increased to 130 hp. Laser beam fluctuations are lowered by 50%. Increased beam length, ground piercing distance, and distance of maximal damage. Reduced damage penalty for each subsequent target by 60%.

dictionary.message: Very accurate and powerful rifle, capable of piercing several enemies with one shot, but each subsequent target gets lower damage. Enemy can't dodge from attack! Always deals critical damage when the ability is available!

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.DAMAGE.U3B
message.value: 130 hp for the first target.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: When activated, damages units with additional poison explosion. Units hit by the explosion lose 3 points of the 'Poison duration (self)' parameter (up to 0) for 8 turns. The radius of the gas cloud has been increased by another 25%.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DESCR.U2A
message.value: When activated, damages units with poison explosion and emits a cloud, which deals poison damage to all units it covers at the end of a turn. Units hit by the explosion lose 3 points of the 'Poisoning' parameter (up to 0) for 8 turns. Unit can't dodge this damage. Cloud lasts for 6 turns. Can be activated by pressing SPACE.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DAMAGE.U2A
message.value: 50 hp from explosion, 50-75 hp each turn

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: When activated, damages units with additional frost explosion.

dictionary.message: When activated, damages units with frost explosion and emits a cloud, which deals frost damage to all units it covers at the end of a turn, slows enemies for 1 turn. Unit can't dodge this damage. Cloud lasts for 6 turns.

message.name: GAS_GRENADE.DAMAGE.U2B
message.value: 50 hp from explosion, 50 hp each turn

message.name: FIREWORK.NAME.U1
message.value: Dragon's breath

message.name: FIREWORK.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Increased drill distance. Improved targeting.

message.name: FIREWORK.NAME.U2
message.value: Storm fury

message.name: FIREWORK.DISTINCT.U2
message.value: Damage decreased by 15, and depends on shock bonuses. Ignores force field.

message.name: FIREWORK.DAMAGE.U2
message.value: 35 hp from explosion. Units, that were impaled by the firework, also get 20 hp of damage plus the damage of falling to ground.

message.name: PUPPET.NAME.U1
message.value: Anna and Belly

message.name: PUPPET.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: You can throw one more doll per fight, but their health is reduced to 120 hp.

message.name: PUPPET.DESCR.U1
message.value: The doll is attached to the fighter and intercepts health gains, it can be removed only by self or allied damage, the health of the doll 120 hp.

message.name: PUPPET.NAME.U2A
message.value: The cursed child

message.name: PUPPET.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: Bites off 10 hp for each allied treatment.

message.name: PUPPET.DESCR.U2A
message.value: The doll is attached to the fighter and intercepts health gains. Bites for 10 hp each time one of the allies of the doll bearer restores health.

message.name: PUPPET.DAMAGE.U2A
message.value: 10 hp when hit, 10 hp when destroyed, 10 hp for each ally health gain

message.name: PUPPET.NAME.U2B
message.value: Ghostly Mandy

message.name: PUPPET.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Passes through ground, has slight homing on enemies.

message.name: PUPPET.DESCR.U2B
message.value: The doll is attached to the fighter and intercepts health gains. Can be thrown through the ground, and has a slight homing on enemies.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.NAME.U1
message.value: Angry mimicry

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Added significant damage on direct hit depending on the number of removed attack points. Added improved scope. A direct hit removes attack points for 4 more turns, and a hit on the ground near a enemy takes 2 more turns.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DESCR.U1
message.value: Reduces the attack points of a target or group of targets within a small radius. Direct hit increases damage. Improved scope.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DAMAGE.U1
message.value: 10 hp, +4 hp for each deducted point for direct hits

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.NAME.U2A
message.value: Fatal mimicry

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: Additionally blocks all attack bonus gains by the target.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DESCR.U2A
message.value: Reduces the attack points of a target or a group of targets in a small radius, also forbids any attack increase.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.NAME.U2B
message.value: Inverse mimicry

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Decreases armor instead of attack, up to 40 points from direct hit, or up to 50 points for a group of targets. The armor reduction when hitting ground near enemy lasts 2 more turns longer.

message.name: THEIF_ATTACK.DESCR.U2B
message.value: Reduces the armor of a target by 40 on direct hit, or by 50 for a group of targets.

message.name: CIRCUS_CANNON.NAME.U1
message.value: Circus cannon mk2

dictionary.message: Launches your fighter over a long distance. When they hit the ground there is a powerful explosion, also dealing minor damage to your fighter. Improved crosshair.

message.name: CIRCUS_CANNON.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Added improved crosshair. Explosion damage increased by 60 hp, damage to your fighter decreased by 10 hp.

message.name: CIRCUS_CANNON.DAMAGE.U1
message.value: 180 hp, 30 hp to your unit.

message.name: DISC_LAUNCHER.NAME.U1
message.value: Improved disc launcher

dictionary.message: Shoots sharpened discs that bounce off any surface. The disc explodes either when it hits the enemy, or after 4 bounces. Disk damage increases with every bounce. Improved crosshair with an approximate trajectory after the first bounce.

message.name: DISC_LAUNCHER.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: Added improved crosshair. Minimal damage increased by 30 hp, maximal by 50 hp.

message.name: HELICOPTER.NAME.U1A
message.value: Attack helicopter

dictionary.message: It's now possible to attack enemy without leaving your hideout! Helicopter carries 6 bombs. Press SPACE, to drop them. If you press SPACE after using all of your bombs, helicopter falls and explodes. Picking a weapon crate with helicopter gives it additional bomb.
Helicopter carries 2 more bombs. Fuel increased by 50%.

message.name: HELICOPTER.NAME.U1B
message.value: Armored helicopter

dictionary.message: It's now possible to attack enemy without leaving your hideout! Helicopter carries 4 bombs. Press SPACE, to drop them. If you press SPACE after using all of your bombs, helicopter falls and explodes.
Does not explode when dropping bombs close to an obstacle. Fuel increased by 20%.

message.name: SOUL_GUN.ON_SHIFT.NOTE
message.value: While holding SHIFT, the hungry souls of your chosen allies first.

dictionary.message: Must be used near one of the enemy characters. When the grenade explodes, it creates a black hole that attracts surrounding fighters and objects. Fighters affected by the black hole take damage from impact with the ground and also destroy a small area of ground as they fall. The black hole ignores weight and knockback bonuses. After three seconds, the black hole disappears, dealing a small amount of damage.

Ignores the Weighting and Pushback force bonuses. Increased maximum attraction radius and knockback, added improved aim. Must be used next to one of the enemy characters. When falling, the fighters pierce a small area of the ground, and after being in the centre of the hole, they are no longer attracted. Automatically triggers after some time after throwing, no timer and no SPACE activation.

message.name: CANNON.NAME.U3A
message.value: Portable cannon

message.name: CANNON.DISTINCT.U3A
message.value: Added second shot, can move between shots. Projectile damage reduced by 25, explosion radius also reduced.

dictionary.message: The cannon fires a cannonball that bounces off walls and only explodes when it comes to a complete stop. The cannon has 2 shots, you can move between shots.

message.name: CANNON.DAMAGE.U3A
message.value: 2 shots by 90 hp each

message.name: CANNON.NAME.U3B
message.value: Contact cannon

message.name: CANNON.DISTINCT.U3B
message.value: Projectile sticks to surface and explodes with a delay.

dictionary.message: The cannon fires a cannonball that sticks to the surface and detonates after a delay.

message.name: CANNON.DAMAGE.U3B
message.value: 115 hp

message.name: CANNON.DAMAGE.U3B.ON_SHIFT.NOTE
message.value: Holding SHIFT still bounces off walls and explodes after coming to a complete stop.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.NAME.U1
message.value: Throwing field

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DESCR.U1
message.value: A device that creates a force field that repels most types of projectiles. Works for 10 turns. Can be activated by pressing SPACEBAR. Cannot be moved by any UFO modification.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DISTINCT.U1
message.value: The field can be thrown over a distance and activated by pressing SPACEBAR. Cannot be moved by any UFO modification.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.NAME.U2A
message.value: Singular field

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DESCR.U2A
message.value: A device that creates a reverse force field that attracts most types of projectiles. Works for 10 turns. The field's range is displayed when you hover over it.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DISTINCT.U2A
message.value: Instead of repelling projectiles, attracts them. The field's range is displayed when you hover over it.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.NAME.U2B
message.value: Atlas Palm

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DESCR.U2B
message.value: A device that creates a powerful force field that repels most types of projectiles. Works for 10 turns.

message.name: FORCE_FIELD.DISTINCT.U2B
message.value: Increased gravitational influence.
